verify.note: Six consequences, each the reversal of something the audit found. Rewritten by LIVE-475 to RUN the vocabulary instead of grepping for its exports: isDestructiveChange is asked about archive, a Cancelled stage and a plain retitle; parseVeraConfirmed is fed an out-of-range index, a string, a fraction and a non-list; destructiveConfirmation must produce words for a destructive line; and describeChange must name the real Plan out of buildVeraDescribeContext rather than falling back to "that Plan". The server refusal, the untickled default and the false invariant comment are still read from source (a server action and a .tsx cannot be imported by a probe), now comment-stripped and whitespace-normalised, with the comment arm reading the RAW file so a re-added comment cannot hide behind the strip. Mutation-tested 2026-09-23: archive dropped from isDestructiveChange, parseVeraConfirmed made to trust its payload, and the server's `&& !confirmed.has(i)` removed each fire the arm that names them. The first two left the OLD probe green, which is why this row was rewritten.
